_comment: LILYGO T3-S3 LR1121, non-PA version. ESP32-S3FH4R2, 4 MB flash, 2 MB PSRAM. Receive-only ELRS telemetry sniffer.
_comment_serial: No flight-controller UART pins. GHOST_SERIAL_RAW sends complete CRSF frames to native USB CDC; the diagnostic target sends readable logs and CRSF hex.
_comment_irq: ELRS calls its IRQ field radio_dio1; on LR1121 this is the DIO9 signal, wired to ESP32 GPIO36. BUSY is GPIO34, unlike the SX1280 board.
_comment_rfsw: LR1121 DIO5/6 control the non-PA board RF switch: enable=3, standby=0, RX LF=1, TX LP=2, TX HP=2, TX HF=0, GNSS=0, RX HF/WiFi=0. Do not add power_rxen/power_txen on ESP32 GPIO21/10: these pins connect to LR1121 DIO7/8.
_comment_tcxo: The board requires 3.0 V TCXO control. This is configured by the LR1121 driver integration using GHOST_LR1121_TCXO=6, not a hardware JSON key in ExpressLRS 3.5.6.
_comment_band: The target scans only 2.4 GHz LoRa. ELRS 3.5.6 still requires a primary sub-GHz regulatory-domain build option for LR1121; the secondary 2.4 GHz hopping table is always ISM2G4. LR1121 cannot receive SX1280 FLRC modes F500/F1000/D250/D500. Use the separate 2.4 GHz IPEX antenna port on the radio module.
_comment_power: Only a 0 dBm power-table entry is provided. GHOST_NO_TX prevents RF transmission; these entries also keep unused TX configuration conservative.
_comment_screen: The OLED is driven by devGhostDisplay.cpp on SDA18/SCL17. No ELRS screen_* keys are used.
